title: Adding up 1 to n
description: sum_to_n(n) should add up every whole number from 1 to n, including n itself. n is never negative, and sum_to_n(0) is 0.

bug.summary: range(1, n) stops before n, so the last number is never added.

hints.1: Think about exactly which numbers your loop visits. Does the sequence include both ends of 1 to n?
hints.2: Look at the `range(1, n)` call on line {line} and write out the values it produces when n is 3.
hints.3: `range` stops before its second argument, so `range(1, n)` never reaches n and the last number is left out of the total. Change the end point so that n itself is included.
